name: oci-bm-gpu-b200-emr
_source: OCI BM.GPU.B200 with Xeon Platinum 8592+ (Emerald Rapids). Read inside a Kata TD on oke-us-phx-1-cc-prod: CPUID leaf 1 from /proc/cpuinfo and the SMBIOS type 4 ProcessorId, the address width from /proc/cpuinfo ('52 bits physical'), and the BAR sizes from lspci -vv of a passed-through B200.
